caller.notes: Tall black figure, tilted head, smile line via setSmile(0..1).

black_shirt_girl.name: Black Shirt Girl
black_shirt_girl.notes: Head front face 1.125 x 1.127 (classic rounded head, own mesh bounds at height 5.2). Free model 'Become A Girl Simulator NPC'. Dark skin, long wavy black hair (Acc_Handle1 under Head), black crop top + jeans (all on the Pants template). Big anime eyes + open smile baked face. Accessories are Acc_* nodes; headNoFace is a full copy of the body atlas with only the face tile (px 901-1002 x 8-120) painted skin, so it can replace the Head mesh map directly.

cat_girl.name: Cat girl
cat_girl.notes: Head front face 1.065 x 1.067 (classic rounded head, own mesh bounds at height 5.2). Free model 'Neko girl IA'. Black hair, black cat ears, collar with bell (under Torso), black tail (under Torso), red patterned sweater, bare legs. One shared atlas material. Accessories are Acc_* nodes; headNoFace is a full copy of the body atlas with only the face tile (px 901-1002 x 8-120) painted skin, so it can replace the Head mesh map directly.

cat_girl_white.name: Cat girl white
cat_girl_white.notes: Head front face 1.087 x 1.088 (classic rounded head, own mesh bounds at height 5.2). Free model 'Neko Cat girl Catgirl'. White ribbed sweater, black cat-ear hair + front hair strands, black tail (under Torso), striped thigh socks. Model was saved posed: limbs reset to R6 rest in conversion (pose_fix.json). Legs are 2.07 studs (slightly long). Accessories are Acc_* nodes; headNoFace is a full copy of the body atlas with only the face tile (px 901-1002 x 8-120) painted skin, so it can replace the Head mesh map directly.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.notes: Head front face 1.045 x 1.046 (classic rounded head, own mesh bounds at height 5.2). Free model 'Teacher ( Girl )'. Brown hair bun (Acc_Handle1, low-res 32px texture), black glasses (Acc_Handle2), both under Head. Pink vest + red bow over white shirt, pink skirt, white socks, brown shoes. Accessories are Acc_* nodes; headNoFace is a full copy of the body atlas with only the face tile (px 901-1002 x 8-120) painted skin, so it can replace the Head mesh map directly.

narrator_boy.name: Narrator boy (hero)
narrator_boy.notes: Free model 'NPC boy'. Blonde spiky hair (Acc under Head), band-aid on cheek, grey plaid shirt over grey hoodie, plaid pants. Baked smile face. Use as the hero.

friend_boy.name: Best friend boy
friend_boy.notes: Free model 'Boy R6 Rig'. Brown beanie + dark hair (Acc under Head), green/cream varsity jacket 'C 11', black cargo pants. Head has NO face decal, so faceSwap adds the kit faces.

mom_brown.name: Mom
mom_brown.notes: Free model 'Mom's NPC'. White bucket hat with butterfly, long brown pigtails, white tee, light-blue overalls, white shoulder bag (under Torso). Freckles + smile baked face. Saved facing +X in Studio: rotated 90 deg in the OBJ before converting (mom_brown_orig.obj.bak).

dad_white.name: Dad
dad_white.notes: Free model 'Dad's NPC'. Black hair, white button shirt with pocket, grey jeans, brown shoes. Smile face. Studio exported the scaled body parts at default size: limbs/torso were scaled x1.218 about their centres in the OBJ (dad_white_orig.obj.bak). Use as Mr Miller or any dad.

grandpa.name: Grandpa
grandpa.notes: Free model 'Old Man Jack' (R15, body parts classified by position). Brown fedora, long white beard (Acc under Head), brown jacket, blue jeans, sneakers. Use as Mr Ortiz / old neighbour. R15 head UVs: face tile differs from R6 (see report).

grandma.name: Grandma
grandma.notes: Free model 'Velinha'. White curly hair + glasses (Acc under Head), light-blue knit sweater with white collar, mauve pants. Dark brown skin on the head texture (hands are lighter).

little_sister_b.name: Little sister (Mia)
little_sister_b.notes: One of two girls in free model 13703622287 (Aris picked it). Blonde pigtails with mint bows, pink/white striped top, open-mouth happy baked face. R15, parts by position. Kid height 4.2. The black-haired twin (little_sister) is not exported yet.

tall_shadow.name: Tall shadow (Caller monster)
tall_shadow.notes: Free model 'Backrooms Monster'. Thin black creature, very long branching legs and arms, blob head. ONE mesh: exported as a single rigid 'Torso' node with no limbs, so it can't walk; move it with stiff glides, tilts and sudden jumps (fits the monster gait rule). No face.

little_sister.name: Little sister (dark pigtails)
little_sister.notes: Twin of little_sister_b from free model 13703622287: black pigtails with mint bows + strawberry clips, pink strawberry overalls. Studio exported no body texture, so the body atlas is little_sister_b's (same outfit and face). Closest to Mia's brown pigtails. R15, kid height 4.2.

horned_shadow.name: Horned shadow (monster)
horned_shadow.notes: Free model 'The Backrooms Monster' (Aris's Monster 1). All-black blocky figure with small devil horns (Acc under Head); one long right arm. Saved hunched: torso and head are baked tilted and the limbs keep small gaps, which reads as creepy. Studio exported it facing -X with unscaled limbs: the OBJ was turned 90 deg and each limb scaled to its Studio size (horned_shadow_orig.obj.bak). No face; give it red glowing eyes in the shot if needed.

black_dress_girl.name: Black dress girl
black_dress_girl.notes: Aris's pick (2026-11-09). Free model 'GIANT GIRL' (scaled to normal size). Long black hair with grey streaks, black fur ushanka with a white cross, black sleeveless dress with a skin-coloured heart. Her in-game face was a mesh Face accessory (dropped, see _work/black_dress_girl/convert.json); its drawing is the image face neutral_droopy_eyes_girl, set as defaultFace so it shows unless a shot calls setFace. Hair and hat decimated to 1500 faces each. The baked atlas face (lipstick smile) is cut out of headNoFace.

anime_girl.name: Anime wolfcut girl
anime_girl.notes: Aris 2026-11-10. R6 body + Anime Wolfcut Hair (asset 14982896047, Acc_Handle1, decimated to 1500 faces). Head has no baked face: faceSwap lets kit/image faces work. Body is default skin/untextured: recolour with a recolor preset or re-export with shirt/pants IDs in a HumanoidDescription.
